    return main_guy_on_tv[0] if main_guy_on_tv else closest_person

def answer_seated_man_question(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    
    if not man_patches:
        return "No man found in the image."
    
    seated_man_patches = [patch for patch in man_patches if patch.verify_property("man", "seated")]
    
    if not seated_man_patches:
        return "No seated man found in the image."
    
    seated_man_patch = max(seated_man_patches, key=lambda patch: patch.compute_depth())
    
    location = seated_man_patch.llm_query("In which country is this person located?", long_answer=False)
    
    return f"A seated man is present in the image. He is located in {location}."

    else:
        return "The lady in the middle is not pink."
